officials.note: Elected board chair at the Jan 2026 organizational meeting.

quorum_court.source: Arlington County is governed by a five-member County Board, elected at-large, which chooses its own chair each year; a professional County Manager runs day-to-day operations.

budget_adoption_window.note: The County Manager proposes in February and the County Board adopts in April; the fiscal year begins July 1.

election_blackouts.note: Bright lines: no candidate issues, no active-ballot-measure issues, no named-individual conduct issues.

election_office.name: Arlington County Voter Registration & Elections
election_office.early_voting: Courthouse Plaza (2100 Clarendon Blvd., Suite 320) is open Sept. 18–Oct. 30, weekdays 9 am to 5 pm, and until 7 pm on Oct. 22, 23, 29, and 30. Walter Reed Community Center (2909 16th St. S.) and Langston-Brown Community Center (2121 N. Culpeper St.) open 2 pm to 7 pm on those same four days. All three sites are open Saturdays Oct. 17, 24, and 31 (9 am to 5 pm) and Sundays Oct. 18 and 25 (11 am to 4 pm).
election_office.election_day: You must vote at your assigned polling place, 6 am to 7 pm. Find it at vote.arlingtonva.gov/Elections/Polling-Places.
